BackstoryDef.title: Ashlander foundling
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was traded to a Redoran family after a hard winter on the Ashlands. [PAWN_pronoun] never quite stopped sleeping on the floor, and could still find water in places the family swore had none.

BackstoryDef.title: pilgrim's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] walked the Seven Graces behind devout parents, carrying the supplies and learning the shrine prayers by repetition. Few childhood memories of [PAWN_possessive] take place under a roof.

BackstoryDef.title: guar herder
BackstoryDef.description: Guar are stubborn and bite without warning, and [PAWN_nameDef] looked after thirty of them before reaching adulthood. Dealing with people came later and seemed like an easier version of the same job.

BackstoryDef.title: hearth guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood duty at a councilor's door for most of a century and drew steel more often than the councilor ever admitted. Bonemold armor still feels lighter to [PAWN_objective] than regular clothes.

BackstoryDef.title: Ashlander scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guided House patrols through country that kills the careless, reading ash drifts the way others read a map. [PAWN_pronoun] has a poor opinion of map makers.

BackstoryDef.title: lapsed Ordinator
BackstoryDef.description: The mask came off when the Temple changed its doctrines and [PAWN_nameDef] could not. There is still a hard training in [PAWN_possessive] shoulders, and [PAWN_pronoun] still tends to watch people's hands.

BackstoryDef.title: Temple healer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a sick ward in Ald'ruhn during blight years, which taught [PAWN_objective] what can be cured, what cannot, and how to tell a family the difference.

BackstoryDef.title: Telvanni apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew tired of being a Telvanni master's most disposable possession and left in the night, along with several of the master's books. The House has not forgotten either detail.

BackstoryDef.title: saltrice farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew saltrice on a House plantation until the ash fell too thickly to clear. Everything [PAWN_pronoun] owned fit on one guar, and the guar complained.

BackstoryDef.title: Hlaalu bookkeeper
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody in the district liked House Hlaalu, but everyone needed one of its clerks. [PAWN_nameDef] did the accounts for half of Blacklight and knew exactly who owed what to whom, which eventually became a problem.

BackstoryDef.title: Red Year refugee
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came to Solstheim in the hold of an overloaded ship, with Vvardenfell burning behind it. Few of the children on board ever spoke about that crossing.

BackstoryDef.title: netch herder's child
BackstoryDef.description: On the Ascadian Isles [PAWN_nameDef] walked netch from pasture to pasture, keeping well clear of the tentacles. There were few better ways to learn patience.

BackstoryDef.title: Ashlander whelp
BackstoryDef.description: Born to an Urshilaku camp, [PAWN_nameDef] could follow a guar trail through an ash storm before [PAWN_pronoun] could read a word. The tribe saw no reason to teach the second.

BackstoryDef.title: tomb sweeper
BackstoryDef.description: Every family has dead to look after. [PAWN_nameDef] swept the urns and learned the names, and never quite stopped feeling watched.

BackstoryDef.title: kitchen slave
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born owned, in the kitchens of a Hlaalu estate, until the Argonians came through in the uprising and the question of ownership became rather more complicated.

BackstoryDef.title: Tribunal novice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in Almalexia's temple school, memorizing the sermons of a goddess who stopped answering before [PAWN_pronoun] finished the course.

BackstoryDef.title: Ordinator
BackstoryDef.description: Indoril armor, a golden mask and a mandate from a Temple that had lost its gods: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the oaths anyway, and never decided whether that was faith or habit.

BackstoryDef.title: Buoyant Armiger
BackstoryDef.description: The Armigers were expected to be quick, polite and slightly insufferable, in the manner of Vivec himself. [PAWN_nameDef] managed all three.

BackstoryDef.title: Morag Tong assassin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carried legal writs of execution and delivered them in person. The Tong is licensed, honorable and very clear on the distinction between itself and murderers.

BackstoryDef.title: cliff racer hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was paid by the head to shoot cliff racers off the trade roads. It is a matter of public record that there were always more.

BackstoryDef.title: Redoran watchman
BackstoryDef.description: Duty came before everything in Blacklight, and [PAWN_nameDef] stood the night watch for twenty years without once asking why.

BackstoryDef.title: Solstheim sellsword
BackstoryDef.description: After the Red Year nobody could pay in anything but ash and promises, so [PAWN_nameDef] took those and went to Raven Rock.

BackstoryDef.title: Telvanni Mouth
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sat on the council in place of a wizard who could not be bothered. It is a job that requires tact and frequent changes of address.

BackstoryDef.title: Telvanni conjurer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] apprenticed under a master who treated every student as a spare part. Surviving was the graduation exam.

BackstoryDef.title: tower grower
BackstoryDef.description: A Telvanni tower has to be grown from a single spore, coaxed with spells and years of tending. [PAWN_nameDef] raised three of them and got no credit for any.

BackstoryDef.title: Reclamation apostate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] preached Azura and Boethiah in the back rooms of Mournhold while the Temple was looking the other way. It stopped looking the other way.

BackstoryDef.title: kwama egg alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked the eggmines outside Balmora, buying from miners and selling to wizards. Most of the potions even did what the label said.

BackstoryDef.title: eggminer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent a working life in the kwama tunnels with a lantern and a basket. The workers are peaceful unless you startle them. Then they are not.

BackstoryDef.title: Hlaalu factor
BackstoryDef.description: House Hlaalu will sell anything to anyone, and [PAWN_nameDef] kept the ledgers proving it. Some of those ledgers still exist, which worries a number of people.

BackstoryDef.title: silt strider caravaner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] drove a silt strider between Seyda Neen and Balmora, poking its organs with a stick. It is said to be the ugliest possible way to make an honest living.

BackstoryDef.title: ash farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Nothing is meant to grow in the ash of Vvardenfell. [PAWN_nameDef] grew saltrice in it anyway, and has very little patience for gardeners who complain about their soil.

BackstoryDef.title: bonemold armorer
BackstoryDef.description: It takes resin, patience and the bones of something large. [PAWN_nameDef] has shaped armor in the traditional manner for decades and considers steel a passing fad.

BackstoryDef.title: Balmora street child
BackstoryDef.description: The Odai ran low in summer and that was when [PAWN_nameDef] searched the mud for dropped coins. Balmora's guards were not interested in the competition.

BackstoryDef.title: Ald'ruhn shell climber
BackstoryDef.description: Ald'ruhn is built inside the shell of a dead emperor crab, and there are many ways up it. [PAWN_nameDef] knew them all and was caught on only a few.

BackstoryDef.title: Sadrith Mora mushroom child
BackstoryDef.description: Children in Telvanni towers grow up climbing fungus that was asked politely to become a staircase. [PAWN_nameDef] thought all houses worked like this.

BackstoryDef.title: ash storm survivor
BackstoryDef.description: A storm off Red Mountain closed over the road for three days. [PAWN_nameDef] walked out with a cough and a clear memory of the ones who did not.

BackstoryDef.title: ancestor shrine keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Each night, [PAWN_nameDef] lit a candle and passed along the household news to the bones of a grandmother. She had opinions, or at least everyone acted as if she did.

BackstoryDef.title: Urshilaku yurt child
BackstoryDef.description: The Urshilaku moved with the herds and considered houses a kind of illness. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up under felted hide, with a wise woman always watching.

BackstoryDef.title: Zainab trader's child
BackstoryDef.description: The Zainab sold to anyone, even villagers. [PAWN_nameDef] learned to haggle in two languages before learning why the other tribes looked down on it.

BackstoryDef.title: Erabenimsun whelp
BackstoryDef.description: Among the Erabenimsun, disputes went to the strongest and everyone knew it. [PAWN_nameDef] started settling disputes at age seven with a stick.

BackstoryDef.title: Ahemmusa herder's child
BackstoryDef.description: Guar calves need watching and the Ahemmusa kept many of them. [PAWN_nameDef] once slept out on the Grazelands for a week to find just one.

BackstoryDef.title: Blacklight dockhand's child
BackstoryDef.description: Slave ships, spice ships and ships with no declared cargo all tied up at Blacklight. [PAWN_nameDef] ran between them with hot rice and a sharp ear.

BackstoryDef.title: Mournhold temple page
BackstoryDef.description: Pilgrims crowd Mournhold for one reason or another. As a page, [PAWN_nameDef] led them to Almalexia's temple and pointed out where the good dumplings were.

BackstoryDef.title: Narsis scribe's child
BackstoryDef.description: Narsis has more bookkeepers per household than anywhere else in Morrowind. [PAWN_nameDef]'s bedtime stories often concerned a dishonest contract and how it was found out.

BackstoryDef.title: Vivec canton runner
BackstoryDef.description: A canton of Vivec is a world stacked on itself, and only children really knew the shortcuts. [PAWN_nameDef] carried notes between floors for a copper a trip.

BackstoryDef.title: kwama queen's attendant
BackstoryDef.description: Scribs are tame if treated fairly, and they will warn of trouble in the deep tunnels. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in an egg mine, feeding them and listening.

BackstoryDef.title: scrib jelly thief
BackstoryDef.description: Scrib jelly fetched a fair price, and [PAWN_nameDef] knew which miners slept soundly. Nobody had got round to noticing the jars were gone until much later.

BackstoryDef.title: Dres plantation child
BackstoryDef.description: In Dres country, the fields are saltrice and the hands are enslaved. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the big house and understood it far too late.

BackstoryDef.title: escaped slave's child
BackstoryDef.description: An Argonian nurse carried [PAWN_nameDef] north one winter. Why she took a Dunmer child along is a thing no one living can now explain.

BackstoryDef.title: Dagoth survivor's child
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody in the village spoke about the Sixth House, and nobody spoke about what happened to [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents. The child learned to stop asking.

BackstoryDef.title: Red Mountain watcher
BackstoryDef.description: Each morning, the first job was to look south for smoke. [PAWN_nameDef] did that job at age six and went on doing it well after it stopped helping.

BackstoryDef.title: Raven Rock ash shoveler
BackstoryDef.description: Raven Rock's ash needs clearing away almost daily. A young [PAWN_nameDef] was given a broad shovel and told it would build character.

BackstoryDef.title: Solstheim-born
BackstoryDef.description: Cold, ash, and Nords in the same place: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the refugee colony where they all met. Many Dunmer children there never saw Morrowind at all.

BackstoryDef.title: Redoran cadet
BackstoryDef.description: Duty was the first word, and honor was the second. Anything else a young [PAWN_nameDef] wanted to say had to wait until the elders were finished.

BackstoryDef.title: Telvanni servant's child
BackstoryDef.description: Mages often forget that servants can read. [PAWN_nameDef] dusted a private library for years and retained far more than the owner would have allowed.

BackstoryDef.title: Hlaalu factor's child
BackstoryDef.description: Every family dinner ended up as a negotiation. By nine, [PAWN_nameDef] could bargain a sibling out of dessert and leave them feeling grateful.

BackstoryDef.title: Indoril novice
BackstoryDef.description: Being of the Indoril meant strict lessons on Almalexia, duty and the correct way of looking down on Hlaalu. [PAWN_nameDef] passed them all with marked distaste.

BackstoryDef.title: nix-hound keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Nix-hounds bite, and then they forgive. [PAWN_nameDef] raised a litter of them behind the family's hut and still has the scars from the favorites.

BackstoryDef.title: shalk catcher
BackstoryDef.description: Shalk resin paid better than farming for those small enough to go down the burrows. [PAWN_nameDef] stayed small enough for an unusually long time.

BackstoryDef.title: guar groom
BackstoryDef.description: Rich Dunmer pay for clean guar on festival days. [PAWN_nameDef] brushed scales in the back lot of a Balmora inn and heard all the rumors first.

BackstoryDef.title: trama root gatherer
BackstoryDef.description: Trama grows along the edge of the Ashlands, and it fights back. [PAWN_nameDef] went out with a sack, heavy gloves and a healthy fear of cliff racers.

BackstoryDef.title: Ministry of Truth pilgrim
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was carried to see the moon that Vivec held still above his own city. At that age, it mostly looked like a big rock.

BackstoryDef.title: Dissident Priest's ward
BackstoryDef.description: The ward's guardian kept forbidden texts behind the flour and went missing one evening. [PAWN_nameDef] kept the flour jar and never told a soul.

BackstoryDef.title: Argonian invasion refugee
BackstoryDef.description: Water and arrows came up from the south, and the family went north with a single cart. [PAWN_nameDef] walked behind it for most of Morrowind.

BackstoryDef.title: ghost-touched child
BackstoryDef.description: The family tomb opened to [PAWN_nameDef] one night in a dream, or something near enough. Elders watched the child closely after that and started saying grace twice.

BackstoryDef.title: netch leather cutter
BackstoryDef.description: Boiled netch stinks in a way that gets into the skin. [PAWN_nameDef] cut hides in a yard downwind of everyone and got used to eating alone.

BackstoryDef.title: Azura's Coast fisher
BackstoryDef.description: Slaughterfish come in closer to the rocks on warm nights. [PAWN_nameDef] speared them from a ledge and lost only one fingertip for all that time.

BackstoryDef.title: Tribunal hymn singer
BackstoryDef.description: Hymns to the Three were the first thing [PAWN_nameDef] sang and the first thing later forgotten. The tune still surfaces at odd moments.

BackstoryDef.title: Tel Vos courier
BackstoryDef.description: Going between Telvanni towers was risky, as most had no doors. A rope and a straight face got [PAWN_nameDef] up the ones with no levitating servant to help.

BackstoryDef.title: Blighted caravan orphan
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_possessive] caravan took the blight near Maar Gan. A healer found [PAWN_nameDef] sitting beside the guar, still feeding them, and did not need telling.

BackstoryDef.title: Great House hostage
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was traded to a rival house as a guarantee of a contract, in fine clothes and fair comfort. The contract held, luckily, for nine years.

BackstoryDef.title: muckspunge picker
BackstoryDef.description: Muck comes up to the knee at low tide in Bitter Coast. Children have the right weight for it, so [PAWN_nameDef] picked muckspunge until growing too heavy.

BackstoryDef.title: bonemender's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Bonemold is glue and ground bone, and a bonemender works with both. At eight, [PAWN_nameDef] could already set a broken arm or a broken pauldron.

BackstoryDef.title: Redoran sword-sister
BackstoryDef.description: House Redoran does not care about pedigree on the wall at Ald'ruhn. [PAWN_nameDef] stood there for years, keeping faith and sharpening a blade that needed it often.

BackstoryDef.title: Hlaalu hired guard
BackstoryDef.description: Contracts in Balmora came with a guard clause, and [PAWN_nameDef] was the clause. Payment was fair and the job's main risk was boredom.

BackstoryDef.title: Dres slave hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Runaways head for the Black Marsh border. [PAWN_nameDef] was very good at getting there first and sleeps well, or at least says so.

BackstoryDef.title: Camonna Tong enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: Outlanders in Vvardenfell were bad for business and worse for the old ways. [PAWN_nameDef] explained this to them with a club, in a very traditional manner.

BackstoryDef.title: Ghostgate defender
BackstoryDef.description: Blighted things pressed against the Ghostfence and someone had to look them in the eye. [PAWN_nameDef] served out two tours at Ghostgate and asked to be moved.

BackstoryDef.title: Ashkhan's champion
BackstoryDef.description: Disputes among the Ashlanders go to single combat more often than the villagers realize. The Ashkhan sent [PAWN_nameDef] whenever talking had gone on too long.

BackstoryDef.title: Dres dagger-for-hire
BackstoryDef.description: House Dres pays in saltrice, slaves or silver and is very frank about it. [PAWN_nameDef] took the silver and let the rest be somebody else's sin.

BackstoryDef.title: Telvanni tower guard
BackstoryDef.description: Magister and apprentice alike can kill with a thought, so the guard at the door serves mainly as a courtesy. [PAWN_nameDef] served as one anyway and kept out of arguments.

BackstoryDef.title: Argonian war veteran
BackstoryDef.description: The Accession War came up through Tear with no warning. [PAWN_nameDef] saw whole towns go and still flinches at the smell of swamp water.

BackstoryDef.title: Mournhold high guard
BackstoryDef.description: Silver armor and a hard stare were enough for most days in Mournhold. On the bad days, [PAWN_nameDef] drew steel in the Temple's defense and asked for no thanks.

BackstoryDef.title: Tong sanctioned killer
BackstoryDef.description: A proper writ names the target and the reason, and the Morag Tong kills no one without one. [PAWN_nameDef] held to that strictly, and considered Dark Brotherhood assassins uncouth.

BackstoryDef.title: Ashlander bow hunter
BackstoryDef.description: An Ashlander bow can reach a kagouti long before it reaches you. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up trusting that math with [PAWN_possessive] life.

BackstoryDef.title: ash-dust raider
BackstoryDef.description: Bad storms cover plenty. [PAWN_nameDef]'s band came through the Molag Amur under one and took a caravan that never saw who did it.

BackstoryDef.title: Solstheim fort sergeant
BackstoryDef.description: Fort Frostmoth outlived its Imperial builders and the Dunmer moved in. [PAWN_nameDef] spent long winters mending its walls and managing the snow.

BackstoryDef.title: Great House duelist
BackstoryDef.description: Duels between the Great Houses are legal, well-attended and require paperwork. [PAWN_nameDef] won nineteen of them and filled the forms in promptly.

BackstoryDef.title: caravan outrider
BackstoryDef.description: Silt striders are slow and bandits aren't. Riding the flank of a caravan through Ashlands dust left [PAWN_nameDef] with bad lungs and fine aim.

BackstoryDef.title: Telvanni magister's rival
BackstoryDef.description: Advancement in House Telvanni follows the old rule: whoever survives is correct. [PAWN_nameDef] has been correct three times.

BackstoryDef.title: Temple exorcist
BackstoryDef.description: Family ancestors sometimes get above themselves. [PAWN_nameDef] came with chalk, a censer and a firm tone and put them back where they belonged.

BackstoryDef.title: Sotha Sil's admirer
BackstoryDef.description: Sotha Sil's Clockwork City is supposed to be somewhere nobody can reach. [PAWN_nameDef] built small ticking devices in hopes of being invited anyway.

BackstoryDef.title: Azura's seer
BackstoryDef.description: At Azura's Coast, you can hear prophecy if you're mad or in luck. [PAWN_nameDef] heard something once at dawn and has been insufferable about it ever since.

BackstoryDef.title: Boethiah's scribe
BackstoryDef.description: Boethiah teaches that the old should be thrown down, and [PAWN_nameDef] took notes on how. A few elders came to regret that the student had paid such close attention.

BackstoryDef.title: Mephala's weaver
BackstoryDef.description: Web-spinning means more than spiders where Mephala's faithful are concerned. [PAWN_nameDef] got three noble houses into a feud with a few well-placed letters.

BackstoryDef.title: Ashlander wise woman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] read the omens for a whole clan and kept the Ashkhan from most of his bad ideas. Villagers call this witchcraft and are only partly wrong.

BackstoryDef.title: necromancer of the ancestors
BackstoryDef.description: Dunmer say necromancy is a crime unless the corpse is family, in which case it's a sacred duty. [PAWN_nameDef] worked mainly on the sacred side of that line.

BackstoryDef.title: Corprus physician
BackstoryDef.description: At Tel Fyr, the sick were kept in deep rooms and studied with care. [PAWN_nameDef] served Divayth Fyr's work there and caught nothing, by rare fortune.

BackstoryDef.title: soul gem trapper
BackstoryDef.description: Telvanni enchanters always need filled gems and never ask where they came from. [PAWN_nameDef] filled them and made sure not to be asked either.

BackstoryDef.title: Clockwork apostle
BackstoryDef.description: Word of the Clockwork City came through scraps and rumors, but it was enough. [PAWN_nameDef] joined the few still trying to follow Seht's methods.

BackstoryDef.title: Temple alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: Temple hospitals go through a lot of comberry and a lot of patience. [PAWN_nameDef] brewed for the wounded after each ash storm and rationed both.

BackstoryDef.title: Sixth House defector
BackstoryDef.description: It sang in [PAWN_nameDef]'s dreams for a whole season, and many went where it asked. This one woke up on the road to Kogoruhn and turned back.

BackstoryDef.title: summoner of Tel Mora
BackstoryDef.description: Tel Mora has very strict rules regarding what can be summoned indoors. [PAWN_nameDef] helped write most of them, after a bad evening in the east wing.

BackstoryDef.title: Reclamation lay reader
BackstoryDef.description: After the Tribunal fell silent, someone still had to lead the prayers. [PAWN_nameDef] read the old words to a shrinking room and adjusted the sermons to fit.

BackstoryDef.title: Mouth of a dead lord
BackstoryDef.description: A Telvanni's Mouth speaks for the master. [PAWN_nameDef]'s master has been dead for six years, though the family has not yet told the council.

BackstoryDef.title: mage of the Vvardenfell Guild
BackstoryDef.description: An Imperial Mages Guild post in Balmora meant tea with outlanders and contempt from everyone else. [PAWN_nameDef] put up with both for the library.

BackstoryDef.title: flin distiller
BackstoryDef.description: Flin came from an ancient Dunmer recipe, or so the label said. [PAWN_nameDef] wrote that label, along with the rest of the family's history.

BackstoryDef.title: sujamma smuggler
BackstoryDef.description: Taxes on sujamma are for people without friends at the docks. [PAWN_nameDef] had plenty of friends, a very quiet boat and an uncle in customs.

BackstoryDef.title: comberry farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Comberry takes to ash soil better than most things. [PAWN_nameDef] worked the slopes near Vos, which gave good fruit and a clear view of everything that could go wrong.

BackstoryDef.title: ash yam cultivator
BackstoryDef.description: On Solstheim, ash yams were the only crop that thrived without complaint. [PAWN_nameDef] made a decent living from them and rarely ate anything else.

BackstoryDef.title: glass miner
BackstoryDef.description: Raw malachite cuts in a very different way to steel. [PAWN_nameDef] came up from the mines around Vvardenfell with fine white scars across both hands.

BackstoryDef.title: ebony prospector
BackstoryDef.description: Red Mountain's slopes hold ebony if you're willing to go up there. [PAWN_nameDef] went up seven times and came down with enough to go up an eighth.

BackstoryDef.title: chitin armorer
BackstoryDef.description: Good chitin armor needs an honest shell and a lot of glue. [PAWN_nameDef] could hear a bad joint from across the workshop.

BackstoryDef.title: retainer of the Dres
BackstoryDef.description: Keeping a Dres household running involves counting everything, including people. [PAWN_nameDef] kept the books well and doesn't like talking about them.

BackstoryDef.title: Hlaalu trade lawyer
BackstoryDef.description: Under Hlaalu law, nearly everything is permissible if it was written down properly first. [PAWN_nameDef] charged by the clause and got rich.

BackstoryDef.title: ancestor tomb mason
BackstoryDef.description: Dead Dunmer stay in the family and need room for it. [PAWN_nameDef] cut new niches in ancient tombs while the current residents were, by tradition, consulted.

BackstoryDef.title: cook of the Eight Plates
BackstoryDef.description: Balmora's Eight Plates was far from the only tavern in town, but it had [PAWN_nameDef] at the fire. A good scuttle pie will outlast most politics.

BackstoryDef.title: strider caller
BackstoryDef.description: Silt striders go where they're told, as long as the caller knows which organ to press. [PAWN_nameDef] knew them all and kept a clean rag for after.

BackstoryDef.title: Vivec moneylender
BackstoryDef.description: A canton's lower levels are full of folk who need coin before payday. [PAWN_nameDef] worked from a small room there and collected most of it back with interest.

BackstoryDef.title: bonemold sculptor
BackstoryDef.description: Ordinators wanted statues of the Three and paid promptly. Once the Three fell out of favor, [PAWN_nameDef] went over to memorial work and was busier than ever.

BackstoryDef.title: Raven Rock clerk
BackstoryDef.description: The East Empire Company took ebony from Raven Rock, and the Redoran taxed it. [PAWN_nameDef] sat in the middle and kept two sets of books, both correct.

BackstoryDef.title: funeral singer
BackstoryDef.description: Grief in Morrowind runs on schedule, with a song for every stage of it. Families hired [PAWN_nameDef] to ensure they did it right.

BackstoryDef.title: hide scraper
BackstoryDef.description: Guar hide, netch leather and a little kagouti when the hunting was good. [PAWN_nameDef] worked a small yard in Molag Mar and could tell a hide's age with a thumb.

BackstoryDef.title: Ashlander guide
BackstoryDef.description: Pilgrims paying good silver wanted to reach the shrines without walking into a foyada. [PAWN_nameDef] took them there and collected their stories for free.

BackstoryDef.title: refugee boatman
BackstoryDef.description: Vvardenfell's refugees needed a way across the Inner Sea, and [PAWN_nameDef]'s boat was the one that turned up. Many of them never got to pay.

BackstoryDef.title: kwama forager
BackstoryDef.description: Eggs come out of the dark and go to every table in Morrowind. [PAWN_nameDef] went in with a basket and a lantern, and hoped the warriors were resting.
